name: held-text-names-at-directories-and-local-actions
description: Held text names a file through a directory whose name starts with @ past a path's first segment, and a local action's uses: value names the index file of the directory it writes, so apps/web/@app/main.js and tools/notify/index.js are held and nothing they export is reported. An action in another repository names no file, even where its ref ends in a file's name, so unacted.js, which uses: acme/tools@release/unacted would otherwise name and nothing imports, and its unused export are reported.
